{{Top|leg}}
'''K-NorCo''' was a vehicle manufacturer that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[D3M]], [[B5B]] and [[B5C]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] models were among the [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] they produced.<ref name="Cartel Market">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref>
